about_comments: Native GTK4 desktop client for GNOME (Notion wrapper).
enc_info_body: Encryption status: {status} This client implements advanced security to protect your login session (cookies): 1. No cookies on disk: session cookies are NEVER written to any filesystem file (neither on HDD/SSD, nor on RAM disk in cleartext or encrypted format). 2. Native GNOME Keyring: upon closing or changing settings, cookies are serialized in encrypted JSON format and sent directly to GNOME Keyring as a secure secret. 3. RAM loading: at application startup, cookies are read directly from the Keyring and injected into the WebKit process volatile memory. 4. Temporary data in RAM: local page databases (IndexedDB/Local Storage) reside entirely in volatile RAM (in /run/user/) and are securely shredded (zeroed out) on exit.
keyring_warning_body:
Could not access GNOME Keyring.

The application will start in temporary mode: login cookies will be kept in memory only and will be lost on exit (no data will be written to disk).

Do you want to continue anyway?
